title: 선택적 레이저 용융법으로 제조된 Ti-6Al-4V 합금의 고 주기 피로 특성에 미치는 건식 전해 연마의 영향
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了LPBF Ti-6Al-4V的疲劳性能及干式电抛光的影响，与用户关注的AM生物医学植入物疲劳性能直接相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not link porous structure to stress shielding, does not report osseointegration or surface morphology for biomedical context, and uses standard Ti-6Al-4V without implant-specific design.

summary_zh.motivation: 改善LPBF Ti-6Al-4V的高周疲劳性能，降低表面粗糙度的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用热等静压和固溶时效处理，再通过干式电抛光降低表面粗糙度。
summary_zh.result: 干式电抛光将表面粗糙度从6.21 μm降至3.15 μm，疲劳极限从150 MPa提升至170 MPa。
summary_zh.validation: 通过疲劳测试对比抛光前后的S-N曲线验证效果。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the high cycle fatigue resistance of selective laser melted Ti-6Al-4V by reducing surface roughness without weight loss.
summary_en.method: Hot isostatic pressing and solution treatment/aging were applied, followed by dry-electropolishing to reduce surface roughness.
summary_en.result: Dry-electropolishing reduced surface roughness Ra from 6.21 μm to 3.15 μm and increased the fatigue limit from 150 MPa to 170 MPa.
summary_en.validation: Fatigue testing (S-N curves) comparing as-built and polished specimens.

title: Prediction and optimization of epoxy adhesive strength from a small dataset through active learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了主动学习在小数据集下优化材料性能的方法，可迁移至生物力学设计中的代理模型构建与优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 小样本聚合物实验数据限制了机器学习在材料设计中的应用。
summary_zh.method: 结合主动学习与贝叶斯优化，迭代提出实验配方。
summary_zh.result: 三轮主动学习后，胶粘剂强度达到35.8±1.1 MPa。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测试验证预测的胶粘强度。

summary_en.motivation: Small experimental datasets in polymer science hinder the application of machine learning for material discovery.
summary_en.method: An active learning pipeline combined with Bayesian optimization iteratively proposes experimental formulations.
summary_en.result: After three active learning cycles, the adhesive joint strength reached 35.8 ± 1.1 MPa.
summary_en.validation: Experimental mechanical testing validated the predicted adhesive strength.

summary_en.motivation: Uncertainty quantification and propagation across multi-scale model/experiment chains are critical for decision-based materials design in ICME.

why_not_core: No validation on biomedical or implant design problems; lacks uncertainty quantification beyond point predictions; does not address constraints handling.

summary_en.motivation: To enable approximation and uncertainty quantification for systems with arbitrary parameter distributions where traditional interpolation nodes are difficult to define.

summary_en.validation: Validated on synthetic experiments and an epidemiological simulation case study.

title: Sampling Acquisition Functions for Batch Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的批量贝叶斯优化方法可应用于代理模型辅助的设计优化，提高采样效率。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification beyond acquisition, or implant/biomechanics applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高批量贝叶斯优化的采样效率，使其可并行化任意序贯采集函数。
summary_zh.method: 提出采集汤普森采样（ATS），通过对模型超参数后验采样生成多个采集函数。
summary_zh.result: 在基准函数和超参数优化任务上，ATS优于经典并行汤普森采样，与先进方法竞争力强。
summary_zh.validation: 在多种基准函数和梯度提升树超参数优化上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To enable efficient parallelization of any sequential acquisition function in Bayesian optimization.
summary_en.method: Proposes Acquisition Thompson Sampling (ATS), which samples multiple acquisition functions from a stochastic process defined by model hyper-parameters.
summary_en.result: ATS outperforms classical parallel Thompson Sampling and is competitive with state-of-the-art batch BO methods on benchmark functions and hyperparameter optimization.
summary_en.validation: Validated on synthetic benchmark functions and hyperparameter tuning of a gradient boosting tree algorithm.

title: Gaussian Process Optimization with Adaptive Sketching: Scalable and No Regret
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种可扩展的高斯过程优化方法，适用于高维黑箱函数优化，其自适应草图技术可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的高效采样与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any biomedical application; it focuses on theoretical GP optimization with no physical simulation validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高维高斯过程优化中计算成本过高的问题
summary_zh.method: 结合GP-UCB与基于杠杆分数采样的随机矩阵草图，实现近常数复杂度
summary_zh.result: 在近最优遗憾下实现近常数每轮复杂度，避免方差饥饿
summary_zh.validation: 理论证明与有效维度界分析

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the prohibitive computational cost of Gaussian process optimization in high-dimensional spaces.
summary_en.method: Combines GP-UCB with randomized matrix sketching via leverage score sampling to achieve near-constant per-iteration complexity.
summary_en.result: Achieves near-optimal regret with near-constant per-iteration complexity and avoids variance starvation.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical regret bounds and effective dimension analysis.

relevance_to_user: 该论文通过调控3D打印参数原位控制钛合金表面微结构以促进骨整合，与用户对增材制造生物医用植入物的骨整合研究方向直接相关。
why_not_core: Paper does not quantify stress shielding, stiffness matching, or any mechanical testing (fatigue or static compression), and lacks porous structure design linking to implant mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过原位控制3D打印表面微结构提升钛合金植入体的骨整合能力。
summary_zh.method: 调整激光路径和扫描间距，结合水热处理构建三种微米级表面形貌及纳米级叠加结构。
summary_zh.result: 条状-球状复合表面叠加纳米结构展现出最优的成骨分化潜力。
summary_zh.validation: 小鼠颅骨前成骨细胞培养评估细胞相容性和成骨分化。

summary_en.motivation: To tailor surface microstructures of Ti alloy implants during 3D printing for enhanced osseointegration without post-processing.
summary_en.method: Laser path and hatching space were varied to produce stripy, bulbous, and composite surface textures, with nano-features added via hydrothermal treatment.
summary_en.result: The bulbous-stripy composite surface with nano-structure showed the highest osteogenic differentiation potential.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cytocompatibility and osteogenic differentiation were assessed using MC3T3-E1 preosteoblastic cells.

title: Active learning for enumerating local minima based on Gaussian process derivatives
relevance_to_user: 该方法基于高斯过程导数进行主动学习，可高效枚举黑箱函数的局部极小值，对优化问题有借鉴意义，但未涉及FEA或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification for design, or biomechanical implant applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效枚举黑箱函数的全部局部极小值解
summary_zh.method: 基于高斯过程导数的主动学习，逐步选择输入点更新导数置信区间
summary_zh.result: 理论分析和数值实验证明了方法的有效性
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently enumerate all local minima of a black-box function using active learning.
summary_en.method: Proposes an active learning method that sequentially selects input points to update confidence intervals of Gaussian process derivatives.
summary_en.result: Theoretical analysis and numerical experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on synthetic functions.

title: Local Function Complexity for Active Learning via Mixture of Gaussian Processes
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于局部函数复杂度的主动学习方法可提高高斯过程回归的采样效率，适用于代理模型构建，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no implant/biomechanics context, no constraint handling or UQ beyond active learning.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高高斯过程回归在非均匀数据上的采样效率
summary_zh.method: 基于局部多项式平滑的局部函数复杂度估计，并推广到高斯过程回归
summary_zh.result: 在量子化学力场重建任务中以更少训练数据达到最优性能
summary_zh.validation: 低维合成数据与量子化学力场重建任务验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve sampling efficiency of Gaussian process regression under data inhomogeneities by estimating local function complexity.
summary_en.method: Derives a Gaussian process regression-based analog of local function complexity from local polynomial smoothing and uses it in an active learning framework.
summary_en.result: Achieves state-of-the-art performance on quantum chemical force field reconstruction with significantly reduced training demand.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a low-dimensional synthetic dataset and a real-world quantum chemical force field reconstruction task.

title: High-dimensional Bayesian optimization using low-dimensional feature spaces
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种高维贝叶斯优化方法，可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: No validation on FEA or biomechanics problems; no uncertainty quantification beyond standard BO; no constraint handling for implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 贝叶斯优化在高维问题中效率低，需降维方法。
summary_zh.method: 联合学习低维特征空间、响应面和重建映射，在子空间优化采集函数。
summary_zh.result: 在低维子空间优化显著简化问题，重建映射用于评估黑箱函数。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准高维优化基准测试上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Bayesian optimization struggles with high-dimensional problems due to the curse of dimensionality, motivating dimensionality reduction.
summary_en.method: Proposes joint learning of a low-dimensional feature space, response surface, and reconstruction mapping, optimizing the acquisition function in the subspace.
summary_en.result: Optimization in the low-dimensional subspace significantly simplifies the problem, with reconstruction mapping used to evaluate the black-box function.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard high-dimensional optimization benchmarks.

title: Deeper Connections between Neural Networks and Gaussian Processes Speed-up Active Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出用高斯过程近似贝叶斯神经网络以加速主动学习，其不确定性估计方法可迁移至代理模型中的主动采样，但未涉及FEA或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address finite element analysis, surrogate modeling for expensive simulations, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on active learning for neural networks with Gaussian process approximations.

summary_zh.motivation: 主动学习效率低且神经网络不确定性估计过自信
summary_zh.method: 用高斯过程近似贝叶斯神经网络，无需重训练即可更新不确定性
summary_zh.result: 在化学和物理建模任务上优于现有方法
summary_zh.validation: 在多个真实世界数据集上对比实验

summary_en.motivation: Active learning for neural networks suffers from computational inefficiency and overconfident uncertainty estimates for out-of-sample points.
summary_en.method: The authors approximate Bayesian neural networks with Gaussian processes to update uncertainty estimates without retraining.
summary_en.result: The proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art active learning methods on real-world chemical and physical modeling tasks.
summary_en.validation: Empirical validation on multiple real-world datasets including large-scale chemical and physical modeling problems.

title: Topological Bayesian Optimization with Persistence Diagrams
relevance_to_user: 该论文将拓扑数据分析（持续同调）与贝叶斯优化结合，可迁移至植入物设计中的多目标优化和约束处理。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no biomedical context, no implant mechanics, no uncertainty quantification beyond standard GP.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有贝叶斯优化无法处理结构数据，需利用拓扑信息提升优化效率。
summary_zh.method: 提出拓扑贝叶斯优化，用持续同调提取拓扑特征并构建核函数。
summary_zh.result: 在结构优化任务中优于随机搜索和图贝叶斯优化基线。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成和真实结构优化基准上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard Bayesian optimization cannot handle structured data, motivating the use of topological information to improve optimization efficiency.
summary_en.method: Proposes topological Bayesian optimization that extracts topological features via persistent homology and constructs a linear combination of kernels for persistence diagrams.
summary_en.result: Outperforms random search and graph Bayesian optimization on structural optimization tasks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on synthetic and real-world structural optimization benchmarks.

title: Multiscale Gaussian Process Level Set Estimation
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种多尺度高斯过程水平集估计算法，可高效处理昂贵黑箱函数的采样问题，其方法可迁移至生物力学设计中的约束优化和不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or multi-objective constrained optimization; it focuses on level set estimation for general black-box functions.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效估计昂贵黑箱函数的水平集，降低计算成本。
summary_zh.method: 提出多尺度高斯过程水平集估计算法，采用层次化分区探索搜索空间。
summary_zh.result: 算法复杂度低，理论保证优于现有方法。
summary_zh.validation: 理论证明和概率界分析。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently estimate the level set of an expensive black-box function with noisy evaluations while reducing computational cost.
summary_en.method: A multiscale Gaussian process level set estimation algorithm is proposed, which uses a hierarchical sequence of partitions to explore regions at varying detail based on proximity to the level set boundary.
summary_en.result: The algorithm achieves low computational complexity and provides high-probability error bounds that are strictly better than existing guarantees for a large class of GPs.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical analysis with probabilistic bounds on estimation error and information gain.

title: Fully Distributed Bayesian Optimization with Stochastic Policies
relevance_to_user: 该方法提出了一种完全分布式贝叶斯优化框架，可结合任意采集函数，对提高昂贵仿真采样效率有潜在价值，但未涉及约束处理、不确定性量化或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constrained optimization, uncertainty quantification beyond standard BO, or any application to implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 贝叶斯优化多为串行，并行化受限，需分布式方法提高吞吐量。
summary_zh.method: 将贝叶斯优化建模为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程，采用玻尔兹曼策略实现完全分布式。
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准测试中展示了方法的性能，可与任意采集函数结合。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准数值基准和若干应用上验证了分布式优化效果。

summary_en.motivation: Bayesian optimization is predominantly sequential, limiting parallelization; a fully distributed approach is needed to scale to high-throughput settings.
summary_en.method: The authors formulate Bayesian optimization as a partially observable Markov decision process and employ a Boltzmann policy to enable fully distributed, scalable optimization with any acquisition function.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves competitive performance on several benchmarks and applications, demonstrating high parallelism without sacrificing optimization quality.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on standard numerical benchmarks and a few application examples, comparing against sequential and parallel BO variants.

key_terms.zh: 部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程

title: Stable Bayesian Optimisation via Direct Stability Quantification
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种在昂贵函数优化中考虑稳定性的贝叶斯优化方法，可迁移至植入物设计中的鲁棒优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or uncertainty quantification for finite element simulations.

summary_zh.motivation: 在物理和工业过程中，输入微小变化可能导致输出剧烈波动，需要找到稳定的最优解。
summary_zh.method: 使用多梯度高斯过程模型估计输出变化超过阈值的概率，并据此引导优化和筛选稳定解。
summary_zh.result: 在合成和实际问题上有效找到了稳定最大值。
summary_zh.validation: 通过合成函数和真实工业案例验证算法有效性。

summary_en.motivation: To find stable maxima of expensive functions where small input variations cause unacceptable output variation.
summary_en.method: Multiple gradient Gaussian Process models estimate the probability that worst-case output variation exceeds a threshold, guiding optimization and post-filtering for stable solutions.
summary_en.result: The algorithm effectively identifies stable maxima on both synthetic and real-world problems.
summary_en.validation: Validation on synthetic benchmarks and a real-world industrial process.

title: Bayesian optimisation under uncertain inputs
relevance_to_user: 该论文处理输入不确定性的贝叶斯优化方法，可迁移至植入物设计中的鲁棒优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive FEA sampling, constraint handling, or biomechanics/implant design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决物理实验中查询位置不确定导致的优化问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出一种处理输入不确定性的上置信界贝叶斯优化算法。
summary_zh.result: 在合成和真实数据上优于其他输入噪声感知方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过模拟实验与基准方法对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To address Bayesian optimisation problems where both the query outcome and the true query location are subject to uncertainty.
summary_en.method: Proposes an upper confidence bound algorithm that uses a Gaussian process model taking probability distributions as inputs.
summary_en.result: The proposed method outperforms conventional and other input-noise-aware BO approaches on simulated scenarios with synthetic and real data.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation on synthetic and real-data simulated scenarios comparing against baseline methods.

title: The surrogate matrix methodology: a priori error estimation
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种加速有限元计算的代理矩阵方法，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的高效仿真。
why_not_core: This paper does not address surrogate modeling for expensive sampling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速有限元分析中矩阵组装的计算瓶颈
summary_zh.method: 通过分段光滑逼近矩阵并投影到高阶多项式子空间构建代理矩阵
summary_zh.result: 在矩阵-free环境下实现高达20倍的计算加速
summary_zh.validation: 通过变系数泊松方程、线弹性和非线性扩散问题的数值实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate the computationally expensive matrix assembly in finite element analysis.
summary_en.method: The surrogate matrix methodology approximates matrices via piecewise smooth projection of stencil functions onto high-order polynomial subspaces.
summary_en.result: Up to twenty-fold reduction in computation time is achieved in a matrix-free environment with geometric multigrid solvers.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on variable-coefficient Poisson, linear elasticity, and nonlinear diffusion problems demonstrate efficacy.

title: Multifidelity Bayesian Optimization for Binomial Output
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种针对二项分布输出的多保真贝叶斯优化方法，可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or uncertainty quantification for continuous outputs; it focuses on binomial outputs and heuristic sample allocation.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准贝叶斯优化假设目标函数为高斯过程，但二项分布输出不满足此假设。
summary_zh.method: 提出一种针对伯努利输出的高斯过程模型，并设计基于期望改进的采集函数和自适应样本分配策略。
summary_zh.result: 该方法能有效处理二项分布输出下的优化问题，平衡探索与利用。
summary_zh.validation: 理论推导和数值示例验证了方法的有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Standard Bayesian optimization assumes Gaussian process surrogates, which are inadequate for binomial-distributed target functions.
summary_en.method: A Gaussian process model for Bernoulli outputs is proposed, coupled with an Expected Improvement acquisition function and a heuristic strategy to adaptively choose the number of samples per evaluation.
summary_en.result: The proposed method effectively handles optimization under binomial outputs, balancing exploration and exploitation.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical derivation and numerical examples demonstrate the method's effectiveness.

title: The Kalai-Smorodinski solution for many-objective Bayesian optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种多目标贝叶斯优化的方法，可迁移到植入物设计中的多目标优化问题，但未涉及约束处理或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency in the context of FEA, does not handle constraints, and lacks uncertainty quantification beyond point predictions.

summary_zh.motivation: 多目标贝叶斯优化在大目标数下效率低且解集不直观，需聚焦特定解。
summary_zh.method: 基于博弈论Kalai-Smorodinsky解，在copula空间优化，设计序贯采样获取函数。
summary_zh.result: 在4-9个目标问题上验证了方法的有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 在四个多目标基准问题上进行数值测试。

summary_en.motivation: Multi-objective Bayesian optimization suffers from low efficiency and poor interpretability with many objectives, motivating a focus on a specific compromise solution.
summary_en.method: The Kalai-Smorodinsky solution from game theory is adopted, objectives are transformed via copula for scale invariance, and a tailored Bayesian optimization algorithm with sequential acquisition functions is proposed.
summary_en.result: The method is demonstrated on four benchmark problems with four to nine objectives, showing effective convergence to the Kalai-Smorodinsky solution.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on synthetic multi-objective problems with varying numbers of objectives.

title: Simplex Stochastic Collocation for Piecewise Smooth Functions with Kinks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的分段光滑函数逼近方法可用于处理生物力学设计中目标函数的不连续性，但未涉及FEA代理模型或不确定性量化在植入物设计中的应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or uncertainty quantification for biomedical design; it focuses on piecewise smooth function approximation for gas networks.

summary_zh.motivation: 高维非光滑函数逼近收敛慢，需利用区域指示信息提高精度。
summary_zh.method: 基于样本点区域指示，在每个光滑区域分别进行多项式插值逼近。
summary_zh.result: 获得全局收敛阶(p+1)/d，无需知道kink精确位置。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试验证收敛阶。

summary_en.motivation: Standard approximation methods fail for non-smooth functions with kinks, motivating a method that exploits region indicators from numerical solutions.
summary_en.method: The function is approximated separately on each smooth region by polynomial interpolation using only an indicator assigning sample points to regions.
summary_en.result: A global convergence order of (p+1)/d is achieved without knowing exact kink locations.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks demonstrate the convergence rate.

title: Osseointegration of titanium scaffolds manufactured by selective laser melting in rabbit femur defect model.
venue: Journal of materials science. Materials in medicine
first_author_affiliation: Department of Oral Rehabilitation, Oral Health and Dental Office Management, Faculty of Dentistry, "Iuliu Hațieganu" University of Medicine and Pharmacy, Cluj-Napoca, Victor Babeș Str., no 15, Cluj-Napoca, Romania.

corresponding_authors.name: Bianca Adina Boșca
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Histology, Faculty of Medicine, "Iuliu Hațieganu" University of Medicine and Pharmacy Cluj-Napoca, Louis Pasteur Str., no 4, Cluj-Napoca, Romania. biancabosca@yahoo.com.

relevance_to_user: 该论文探讨了SLM钛合金支架的骨整合性能，与生物医用增材制造方向直接相关，但缺乏力学测试和应力屏蔽分析。
why_not_core: No mechanical testing (static or fatigue), no stress shielding or stiffness matching analysis, only histology.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估SLM钛支架尺寸和表面涂层对骨整合的影响
summary_zh.method: 植入兔股骨缺损模型，组织学和SEM分析
summary_zh.result: 纳米羟基磷灰石涂层和0.8mm孔径支架骨整合更好

title: A Shapley--Owen Index for Interaction Quantification
first_author_affiliation: Bocconi University

corresponding_authors.name: Giovanni Rabitti
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Bocconi University

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的Shapley-Owen交互效应指数可用于依赖输入下的全局敏感性分析，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的输入特征交互量化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on sensitivity analysis for general models without any FEA surrogate, implant design, or biomechanics context.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有Shapley效应仅量化单个输入重要性，缺乏对输入交互作用的度量。
summary_zh.method: 基于广义Shapley值提出Shapley-Owen指数，用于依赖输入下的全局交互效应量化。
summary_zh.result: 新指数能揭示交互作用的协同/拮抗性质，且适用于依赖输入场景。
summary_zh.validation: 理论推导与公理化验证，无数值实验。

summary_en.motivation: Existing Shapley effects only quantify individual input importance, lacking a measure for input interactions.
summary_en.method: A Shapley-Owen index is proposed based on the generalized Shapley value to quantify global interaction effects under dependent inputs.
summary_en.result: The new index reveals synergistic/antagonistic nature of interactions and handles input dependencies.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical derivation and axiomatic validation, no numerical experiments.

title: A MACHINE LEARNING APPROACH FOR THE INVERSE QUANTIFICATION OF SET-THEORETICAL UNCERTAINTY

corresponding_authors.affiliation: KU Leuven

why_not_core: This paper focuses on set-theoretical uncertainty quantification without application to FEA surrogate modeling or implant biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决集合理论不确定性逆量化问题
summary_zh.method: 采用机器学习方法进行逆不确定性量化
summary_zh.result: 提出了一种新的逆量化框架

summary_en.motivation: To address the inverse quantification of set-theoretical uncertainty in computational models.
summary_en.method: A machine learning approach is developed to inversely quantify set-theoretical uncertainty.
summary_en.result: The proposed framework enables efficient inverse uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated through theoretical analysis and numerical examples.

title: A Kriging‐Based Active Learning Algorithm for Mechanical Reliability Analysis with Time‐Consuming and Nonlinear Response
first_author_affiliation: School of Mechatronics Engineering, Shenyang Aerospace University, Shenyang 110136, China

corresponding_authors.name: Cao Tong
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Mechatronics Engineering, Shenyang Aerospace University, Shenyang 110136, China

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的主动学习Kriging方法可用于解决生物力学有限元分析中计算成本高的问题，但未涉及植入物设计或多目标约束。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on reliability analysis with a single limit state, not on surrogate-based optimization or multi-constraint design for implant biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少高非线性、耗时响应的机械可靠性分析计算量并提高精度。
summary_zh.method: 提出一种新的HPF学习函数，基于Kriging模型主动更新实验设计。
summary_zh.result: HPF方法在显式算例和机械可靠性问题中降低了计算量并提高了精度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过两个显式数值算例和一个机械可靠性案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce computational cost and improve accuracy in reliability analysis of mechanical systems with highly nonlinear and time-consuming responses.
summary_en.method: A new active learning function (HPF) is proposed, which sequentially selects points for Kriging model updating by considering sampling density, misclassification probability, and local/global uncertainty near the limit state.
summary_en.result: The HPF method achieves lower computational cost and higher accuracy compared to traditional reliability methods on both explicit examples and a mechanical reliability problem.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on two explicit numerical examples and one mechanical reliability case study involving time-consuming nonlinear response.

title: A Kriging-Based Dynamic Adaptive Sampling Method for Uncertainty Quantification
venue: TRANSACTIONS OF THE JAPAN SOCIETY FOR AERONAUTICAL AND SPACE SCIENCES
first_author_affiliation: Institute of Fluid Science, Tohoku University

corresponding_authors.name: Koji Shimoyama
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Institute of Fluid Science, Tohoku University

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于Kriging的动态自适应采样方法可用于不确定性量化，可迁移至生物力学代理模型构建中的采样效率问题。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on aerodynamic/analytic functions and does not address implant biomechanics, FEA constraints, or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高Kriging代理模型在不确定性量化中的采样效率
summary_zh.method: 结合拟合不确定性、梯度信息和不同相关长度预测差异的动态自适应采样准则
summary_zh.result: 新方法在精度和鲁棒性上优于多项式混沌展开和仅基于不确定性的自适应采样
summary_zh.validation: 在二维解析函数上验证，对比多项式混沌展开和单一不确定性自适应采样

summary_en.motivation: To improve sampling efficiency of Kriging surrogate models for uncertainty quantification in stochastic spaces with varying smoothness.
summary_en.method: A dynamic adaptive sampling criterion combining expected fit uncertainty, gradient information from Kriging predictors, and an error estimate based on predictor differences across correlation length scales.
summary_en.result: The proposed method outperforms polynomial chaos expansion and uncertainty-only adaptive sampling in accuracy and robustness for estimating statistics of quantities of interest.
summary_en.validation: Validated on two-dimensional analytic functions with smooth and steep responses under normal uncertainty distributions.

title: A GENERAL FRAMEWORK FOR ENHANCING SPARSITY OF GENERALIZED POLYNOMIAL CHAOS EXPANSIONS

why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on stochastic PDEs and high-dimensional problems without biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高有限数据下不确定性量化的效率和精度
summary_zh.method: 通过交替方向法迭代旋转随机变量以增强多项式混沌展开的稀疏性
summary_zh.result: 在随机偏微分方程和高维问题中验证了方法的有效性
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试（随机PDE和高维问题）

summary_en.motivation: To improve the efficiency and accuracy of compressive-sensing-based uncertainty quantification when data are limited.
summary_en.method: An alternating direction method iteratively rotates random variables to enhance the sparsity of generalized polynomial chaos expansions.
summary_en.result: The method demonstrates effectiveness on stochastic partial differential equations and high-dimensional (O(100)) problems.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on stochastic PDEs and high-dimensional problems.

why_not_core: This paper focuses on ODEs with random parameters and does not address PDE-based FEA, implant biomechanics, or multi-objective constrained optimization.

summary_zh.validation: 通过多个数值算例验证准确性

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently compute statistics of quantities of interest for ODEs with random parameters using Monte Carlo sampling.
summary_en.method: A hybrid Monte Carlo method combining the 4th-order Runge-Kutta solver with neural network models is developed.
summary_en.result: The hybrid method achieves comparable accuracy to classical Monte Carlo with significantly reduced computational cost.
summary_en.validation: Numerical examples on ODEs with random parameters verify the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed method.

why_not_core: No fatigue testing, no surface roughness or as-built morphology characterization, and no osseointegration assessment.

title: A 3D Printed Porous Titanium Alloy Rod with Diamond Crystal Lattice for Treatment of the Early-Stage Femoral Head Osteonecrosis in Sheep
first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopaedics, The General Hospital of Western Theater Command, Chengdu, Sichuan 610083, China

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedics, The General Hospital of Western Theater Command, Chengdu, Sichuan 610083, China

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the efficacy of a 3D-printed porous titanium alloy rod with diamond crystal lattice in treating early-stage femoral head osteonecrosis.
